Hi, all!

At Bikky, we unify POS, online ordering, payments, and loyalty data to help multi-unit restaurant brands understand their customers and make better business decisions.

We’re a small, growing team working on hard problems across data engineering, infrastructure, AI, and analytics. We’re looking for engineering folks that would help shape technical direction, and build systems that have a real impact on how restaurants operate and grow.

Get to know us and what we build: https://bikky.com
